items.reason: F-phone-1532 Plus free-part limits: 7 own exercises and 3 months of charts come from one shared constant and fail open; switch MEMBER_PLAN_GATE_ON keeps them off. The phone backup and the cloud account copy both leave out the Plus record (free month start, purchase), so a reinstall restarts the free month (same fault as FN-L5-phone-screens-1-03, promise not re-listed) and the member account holds no Plus purchase (same fault as FN-L5-phone-screens-2-02). AI coach runs on the member's own Claude/OpenAI/Groq key: no MettleUp price, credits or wallet here; rounds and tokens are capped. Account backup is free for every member.
No payment, test key or live key in these folders; the only keys are the member's own AI keys, which never leave the phone and are not backed up.

Limit checks never refuse on an error (fail open); restoring on a new phone asks Google Play again rather than copying a paid state, so a refunded or cancelled plan is not revived from a backup. A failed AI call keeps already-saved cards and shows a retry message; no MettleUp charge is involved.

The only numbers here (7 own exercises, 3 months of charts) are read from the shared plan rules, not typed again; the 8th exercise is the first refused, matching 'more than 7'. No rupee amount is shown or stored in these folders.
